title: ¶ Chapt. 4. by true diuiſion, for here beginneth the preface to the proclamation.

segments.text: 31 Nebuchadnezer king, vnto all people, nations, and languages that dwell in all the world, peace be multiplied vnto you.
32 I thought it good to declare the ſignes and wonders that the hye God hath wrought toward me.
33 How great are his ſignes, and how mighty are his wonders: his kingdome is an euerlaſting kingdome, and his dominion is from generation to generation.
